svg.title: RAM map of the Ver.1 firmware
svg.desc: Each nibble coloured by the task that writes it (measured); page 0 labelled.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Colour = the main-loop task or interrupt whose code wrote the nibble (measured from access traces). Pale = read but never written; blank = untouched.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Page 0 holds the game state; the stack grows down from 0FF.
